translation:
In the condition of injury with abdominal pain, if the stool does not pass and pressing makes the pain severe, there is stagnant blood within; use Modified Qi-Guiding Decoction (加味承氣湯) to purge it. If after purging the pain does not stop and pressing still causes pain, the stagnant blood is not exhausted; use Modified Four Substances Decoction (加味四物湯) to supplement and move it. If pressing the abdomen instead does not cause pain, the qi and blood are injured; use Four Substances Decoction (四物湯) with added ginseng (參), astragalus (耆), and atractylodes (白朮) to supplement and harmonize it. If after purging the chest and hypochondrium instead hurt, the liver blood is injured; use Four Gentlemen Decoction (四君子湯) with added chuanxiong (芎) and dang gui (歸) to supplement it. If after purging there is fever, the yin blood is injured; use Four Substances Decoction (四物湯) with added ginseng (參) and atractylodes (朮) to supplement it. If after purging there is aversion to cold, the yang qi is injured; use Ten Complete Great Supplementation Decoction (十全大補湯) to supplement it. If after purging there is aversion to cold and fever, the qi and blood are injured; use Eight Treasures Decoction (八珍湯) to supplement it. If after purging there is a desire to vomit, the stomach qi is injured; use Six Gentlemen Decoction (六君子湯) with added dang gui (當歸) to supplement it. If after purging there is diarrhea, the spleen and kidney are injured; use Six Gentlemen Decoction (六君子湯) with added nutmeg (肉果) and psoralea (補骨脂) to supplement it. If after purging the hands and feet are all cold, with clouding and sweating, the yang qi is deficient and cold; urgently use Ginseng and Aconite Decoction (參附湯). If there is vomiting and diarrhea with the hands and feet all cold and the nails blue, the spleen and kidney are extremely deficient and cold; urgently use a large dose of Ginseng and Aconite Decoction (參附湯). If there is lockjaw, letting go of the hands, urinary incontinence, profuse phlegm, blue lips, and a cold body, this is a failing condition of extreme deficiency; urgently use a large dose of Ginseng and Aconite Decoction (參附湯), and many will be saved. <ins>Modified Qi-Guiding Decoction (加味承氣湯)</ins>
Rhubarb (大黃), mirabilite (朴硝, each two qian), immature bitter orange (枳實), magnolia bark (厚朴), dang gui (當歸), safflower (紅花, each one qian), licorice (甘草, five fen)
With water and wine each half, decoct and take. <ins>Ginseng and Aconite Decoction (參附湯)</ins>
Ginseng (人參, either five qian or one liang), processed aconite (製附子, either three qian or five qian)
With the guiding herb ginger, decoct in water and take.
